# PBT Bug Hunt Report

*Generated by [tim-pbt](https://github.com/schreyack/tim) — a [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) plugin for automated property-based bug hunting.*

**tim-pbt** discovers bugs that hand-written tests miss. Instead of testing specific examples, it generates thousands of randomized inputs guided by properties — invariants your code should satisfy. When an input violates a property, Hypothesis (Python) or fast-check (TypeScript) shrinks it to the minimal failing case, producing a precise, reproducible bug report.

tim-pbt is part of the **TIM** standards framework. Install from within Claude Code:

```text
/plugin marketplace add schreyack/tim
/plugin install tim-pbt@tim
```

Then run `/tim-pbt` in any project to start hunting.

<details>
<summary>Property type legend</summary>

| Code | # | Type | What it checks |
|------|---|------|----------------|
| **Classic** ||||
| RT | 1 | Round-trip / Inverse | `decode(encode(x)) == x` |
| ID | 2 | Idempotence | `f(f(x)) == f(x)` |
| OI | 3 | Output Invariants | Output satisfies documented constraints |
| CA | 4 | Commutativity / Associativity | Order/grouping doesn't change result |
| CC | 5 | Contract Compliance | Honors type hints, docstrings, exceptions |
| CF | 6 | Crash-Free on Valid Input | No unhandled exceptions on well-typed input |
| **Bug-Pattern** ||||
| FV | 7 | Falsy-Value Confusion | Correct behavior for `0`, `False`, `""`, `[]` |
| BO | 8 | Boundary & Off-by-One | Correct at 0, 1, max, max±1 |
| TC | 9 | Type Coercion Traps | No silent wrong results from mixed types |
| NP | 10 | None/Null Propagation | Handles `None` gracefully |
| SV | 11 | Sentinel Value Confusion | Sentinel values distinguishable from valid data |
| CO | 12 | Collection Edge Cases | Handles empty, single-element, large collections |
| SM | 13 | State Mutation Side Effects | Doesn't mutate input arguments |

</details>
